parsed.main_gap: Lemma 2, the essential weight-descent step used to prove that only finitely many primes occur in minimal supports, is asserted without any proof.

errors.description: The proof of Lemma 2 is wholly omitted. This is the central nontrivial bridge from bounded-size finiteness to finiteness of all minimal supports; calling the descent “standard” does not establish the claimed terminal set containing each prime.
errors.quote: **Proof.** This follows by a descent on the weight $w$ (standard; details omitted). $\square$

parsed.notes: The support reformulation, self-duality, sunflower argument, and deduction of translation-periodicity from finiteness of the minimal supports are otherwise coherent. However, the omitted lemma carries the main remaining burden, so the proof is not essentially complete.
